blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Levito Baligod, lawyer of the so-called “Maleta boys,” on Friday posted bail of P30,000 in a libel case filed by Manila 6th District Rep. Benny Abante. In June, Abante filed the case against Baligod and 18 former bodyguards of then-Ako Bicol party-list Rep. Elizaldy “Zaldy” Co over an accusation that Abante had received suitcases of cash during the 19th Congress. Abante vehemently denied their narration. Today, Baligod went to Manila City Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 184 to post a bond and secure his provisional liberty.
